messages:
maya: FYI after today's release (merge set ending 286987) we're seeing an SSE tail increase. p99 token latency up ~420ms vs baseline in prod. CI marked a +10% perf reg. cc @priya @tom :eyes:

tom: I replayed traces from canary. Streaming requests show a long stall during toolcall serialization, then spend a lot of time in kernel_autoselect deciding on a memcpy-heavy kernel for short sequences. Flame link: https://artifacts/replays/trace-2869876543

priya: The release included batching bucket changes (PR 4721) and removal of the kv-prefetch toggle in runtime config. Both touch kernel routing and cache behavior. Who changed kernel_autoselect heuristics?

ashley: Stack samples show blocked on kv-eviction then protobuf marshal in toolcall handler. Canary traffic has more small requests, so the path amplifies latency.

sre-oncall: deploy-bot paused the rollout automatically at 10:04 due to perf alerts. Hold further rollouts?

maya: Hold rollout. @deploy-bot pause.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused by maya at 2024-06-02T10:04:12Z. Reason: perf regression / p99 spike.

tom: I reproduced locally with a streaming stress profile: `perf run --trace stream --model=hera-7b --short-seq`. Snapshot:
``
avg_token_ms: 28
p95_token_ms: 200
p99_token_ms: 448
blocked_us: 360000
kernel_autoselect: picked kernel_c (memcpy-heavy) for many small batches
```
Forcing kernel=c_old removes the stall.

priya: Hypothesis: PR 4721 broadened the small-batch bucket so more short-seqs hit a codepath that triggers kernel_c. Without kv-prefetch, we see higher cache miss -> more blocking during toolcall serialization.

ashley: Quick mitigation: I can push a route-level override to force kernel=c_old for streaming routes. Will draft a PR with extra tracing tags as well.

maya: Do that and start a bisect between the merged commits. @tom can you bisect and capture kernel selection histograms + KV hit rate?

tom: Starting bisect across commits 4680..286987. I'll collect histograms and put artifacts in the bisect folder. Draft PR 4820 created to add kernel override and trace tags: https://git/repo/pull/4820

ci-bot: perf-check: merge-build 286987 -> stream-p99 test +10% regression (p99), details: https://ci.internal/reports/286987

priya: Action plan:
1) Rollout is paused (done)
2) Merge temporary kernel override for streaming (PR 4820)
3) Revert or narrow the bucketing change from PR 4721 depending on bisect
4) Re-enable kv-prefetch or relax eviction settings
5) Rerun CI and monitor canary for 30m

ashley: I'll take step 3 and open a tweak branch to shrink the small-batch bucket. Starting now.

sre-oncall: After PR 4820 hits canary I'll watch p99 and KV hit ratio. Alert threshold: p99 > 300ms.

maya: Good. We need bisect artifacts and kernel histograms here when available; we'll decide on revert vs tweak after the canary window.

tom: Bisect result coming in: commit 4721 (batch bucketing) correlates strongly. Small-batch share up ~30%, kernel_c selection +42% on streaming routes, KV miss rose from ~5% -> ~17%. Logs: https://artifacts/internal/bisect/4721

priya: That matches the hypothesis. Let's land the kernel_override and the bucketing tweak, re-run perf CI. If metrics return to baseline we can roll forward.

deploy-bot: PR 4820 deployed to canary at 2024-06-02T10:36:05Z.

sre-oncall: Canary after override: p99 ~235ms, KV miss back to ~6%. Maintaining canary for 30m before partial rollout.

maya: Nice work. Please post the bisect artifacts and follow-up with a short postmortem if we need a revert. Thanks everyone.
